title: The Toxic Lady: Her Body Made a Gas That Dropped 5 ER Workers Instantly
description:
On February 19, 1994, Gloria Ramirez was rushed into Riverside General Hospital's ER, dying of cervical cancer. Within minutes of drawing her blood, nurses and doctors began collapsing — gasping, seizing, overwhelmed by a garlic-like smell and manila-colored particles floating in her syringe. The ER was evacuated. Gloria died just 35 minutes after arrival.

Toxicology found nothing. Investigators and scientists at Livermore National Lab spent months chasing a bizarre theory: that a pain cream in her system somehow transformed into a lethal gas inside her body — a reaction chemists say shouldn't even be possible in living tissue. No official cause was ever confirmed.

Five hospital workers suffered long-term health damage. The county called it mass hysteria. Her family called it a cover-up. And when her remains were cremated before a second autopsy could happen, any real answers went up with them. Subscribe now 👇
